briefing: I am {PATRON}, governor of {HERE}. The grub yield this season meets quota, and the export ledger tracks it, canister by canister.
The ledger went missing with a smuggler, and the export figures are now unverified. Recover the canister, and see the smuggler answer for it.
Complete this, and your fee follows the numbers, not the story.

ledger.arrive: Scoop the canister adrift at {TARGET}, and earn {PAY}.
ledger.success: The canister is recovered, and {PAY} is credited to you.
ledger.fail: The canister is gone, and {PAY} stays out of reach.

witness.arrive: Hold the partner's Cobra at {TARGET} on your scanner for {PAY}.
witness.success: You held the scan clean, and {PAY} is credited to you.
witness.fail: The scan broke, and {PAY} stays out of reach.

runner.arrive: Destroy the smuggler's Cobra, last seen at {TARGET}, for {PAY}.
runner.success: The smuggler is finished, and {PAY} closes the ledger.
runner.fail: The smuggler slipped free, and {PAY} stays out of reach.

dossier.lead: The commander hears that {PATRON} wants a word at {WORLD}.
dossier.news: The data page at {WORLD} notes that {PATRON} has work waiting for a pilot.

rumour.far: Word on the board says {PATRON} wants a canister found near {WORLD}.
rumour.near: {PATRON}'s message waits one jump out, asking after a lost canister near {WORLD}.

story.opening: On day {DAY}, she took the governor's job at {WORLD}.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the ledger was closed and the smuggler finished, {WORLD} behind her.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the job lay unfinished, and {WORLD} closed the books on her.

ledger.failed: On day {DAY}, the canister was lost near {WORLD}, and the job failed.
